title: Research
text:
Mathematical Modelling
The first stage is to construct mathematical models that describe the progression of a Werewolf game.
A simplified game can be represented using variables such as:

(m): number of villagers
(n): number of werewolves
the current game state
possible actions
the probability of each outcome

These models provide a foundation for analysing more complex game situations.

title: Research
text:
Decision Making
The long-term goal is to investigate how an AI can select actions under incomplete information.
In a Werewolf game, the AI does not know the roles of all players. Therefore, decisions must be made using incomplete and uncertain information.
The project will investigate how probabilities, role information, game history, and possible future states can be combined to evaluate different actions.

title: Research
text:
Current Research
The initial research focuses on the probability of winning under simplified Werewolf game rules.
Future work will extend these models toward more realistic game mechanics and AI decision-making.

title: Experiments
text:
Experiment 1 — Werewolf Win Probability
The first experiment investigates the probability of winning in a simplified Werewolf game.

Research Question
How does the number of villagers and werewolves affect the probability of a werewolf victory?


Method
A simplified game model is defined in which:

players are divided into villagers and werewolves;
one player is eliminated during the day;
a werewolf eliminates a villager during the night;
the game continues until one side reaches its victory condition.

The theoretical probability will be compared with results obtained through repeated simulations.


Results
Results will be added here after the simulation has been implemented.

title: Werewolf Decision AI
text:
This project investigates decision-making in Werewolf games using mathematical modelling, simulation, and artificial intelligence.
The aim is to develop a system that can reason about game states, evaluate possible actions, and make decisions under incomplete information.

title: Werewolf Decision AI

Research Questions

How can a Werewolf game be represented as a mathematical state?
How can the value of different roles and pieces of information be quantified?
How should an AI choose actions under incomplete information?
How do different strategies affect the probability of winning?
